servers.name: FreeIdeaStore
servers.description: AI agent tools for FreeIdeaStore. Use published idea skills, create ideas, read idea research, add evidence, propose and resolve refinements, publish owner-approved canonical updates section by section, browse and revert document revisions, soft-delete owner ideas, react with support/trash/pivot signals, and promote mature ideas toward ProIdeaStore.

tools.name: free_idea_template
tools.description: Return the cheap FreeIdeaStore one-page idea template.

tools.name: list_idea_skills
tools.description: List published FreeIdeaStore idea playbooks for agents and humans.

tools.name: get_idea_skill
tools.description: Fetch a full idea skill/playbook by id.

tools.name: apply_idea_skill
tools.description: Apply a skill to a rough idea or existing idea context and return questions, a checklist, or tool plan.

tools.name: dynamic_idea_book_template
tools.description: Return the canonical Markdown heading spine used by dynamic FreeIdeaStore idea books.

tools.name: dry_run_dynamic_idea_book
tools.description: Preview canonical Markdown and dynamic chapter URLs for a FreeIdeaStore idea without writing files.

tools.name: get_idea
tools.description: Read a FreeIdeaStore idea body, metadata, and optional contribution history.

tools.name: my_ideas
tools.description: List ideas created by the authenticated MCP user.

tools.name: my_activity
tools.description: List ideas and contributions attached to the authenticated MCP user.

tools.name: create_free_idea
tools.description: Create a D1-backed FreeIdeaStore idea page.

tools.name: derive_idea
tools.description: Fork a new idea from an existing one, seeded with the parent body and linked back to the source.

tools.name: add_idea_contribution
tools.description: Record evidence, risk, pivot, prototype, refinement, or kill-signal notes on an idea.

tools.name: propose_idea_refinement
tools.description: Record a structured section-level refinement proposal without overwriting the canonical body.

tools.name: react_to_idea
tools.description: Add a support, trash, or pivot signal to an idea.

tools.name: publish_idea_update
tools.description: Replace the authenticated owner's canonical public idea document, or update only its metadata when body is omitted. Prefer the section tools for anything short of a full rewrite.

tools.name: delete_idea
tools.description: Soft-delete an authenticated owner's idea from public FreeIdeaStore surfaces.

tools.name: promote_to_pro_candidate
tools.description: Mark an authenticated owner's idea as a ProIdeaStore candidate and return a dossier draft.

tools.name: list_idea_sections
tools.description: List an idea document's sections with their ids and word counts. Start here before reading or writing a section.

tools.name: read_idea_section
tools.description: Read one section of an idea document instead of pulling the whole document into context.

tools.name: patch_idea_section
tools.description: Replace one section of the authenticated owner's document, leaving the rest byte-identical.

tools.name: append_to_idea_section
tools.description: Add markdown to the end of one section of the authenticated owner's document.

tools.name: list_idea_revisions
tools.description: List past versions of an idea document, newest first, with author and write kind.

tools.name: read_idea_revision
tools.description: Read the full markdown of one past revision of an idea document.

tools.name: diff_idea_revision
tools.description: Show added and removed lines between a past revision and the current document.

tools.name: revert_idea_to_revision
tools.description: Restore a past revision as the authenticated owner's current document. The revert is itself recorded.

tools.name: list_pending_refinements
tools.description: List refinement proposals on an idea that have not been merged or closed yet.

tools.name: apply_refinement
tools.description: Merge a queued refinement into the authenticated owner's canonical document and close it.

tools.name: resolve_refinement
tools.description: Close a refinement without merging it, recording why.

tools.name: add_idea_section
tools.description: Add a new section to the authenticated owner's document, optionally positioned with after/before.

tools.name: edit_idea_section
tools.description: Rename and/or move a section. Renaming changes the section id, so the old chapter URL stops resolving.

tools.name: merge_idea_sections
tools.description: Fold one section's content into another and drop the source.

tools.name: delete_idea_section
tools.description: Remove a section and its content. Recoverable through revisions.
